title: Flow document
description: One PR's execution flows for the flow-lens renderer. scripts/lib/validate.mjs is the enforcement of this schema (the tool is dependency-free); keep the two in step.

repo.description: GitHub owner/name. Steps link to their file at headSha in this repo; without it the page has no source links.

id.description: Unique across the document; used by the flow picker.

lanes.description: Left-to-right swimlane order; every step's lane must appear here.

steps.description: step.next edges must form a DAG; the renderer walks it topologically.

title.description: Short label on the node box.

note.description: Panel prose; backticks render as code, **double asterisks** as bold.

to.description: A step id in the same flow; never the step itself.

label.description: Edge caption, e.g. the branch condition.

file.description: Repo-relative path. Absent means an infrastructure step (dashed outline, no GitHub link).

fn.description: Function or symbol within the file.

concern.description: What a reviewer must look at; colours the node deterministically by first appearance.

added.description: Lines added in this file by the PR.

runtime.description: Where the step runs (client, node, db, worker, ...); shown as a chip.

inStack.description: true = the PR added or changed this step (solid, coloured); false/absent = existing code the flow passes through (dashed).

pr.description: Attribution chip when a step belongs to another PR, e.g. "#121".
